name: commit-tracker
description: Faculty dashboard for tracking student GitHub contribution activity.

scripts.build:electron: npm run build:preload && npm run build:main
scripts.shot: npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run build:shot && electron --no-sandbox dist-electron/main/shot.cjs
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n "vite,electron" -c "cyan,yellow" "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron . --ozone-platform=x11"
scripts.electron:preview: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --config electron-builder.config.cjs
